propositions: Agents prefer grep over Serena's symbol tools despite documentation, because grep requires zero extra tool invocations while Serena requires a ToolSearch discovery step.

Serena cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib patterns), and its index can lag edits, making grep necessary as a complement in specific cases.
Documentation guidance alone is ineffective at scale: it decays in working memory after multiple turns and has no trigger mechanism or negative feedback when violated.

The workflow must make symbol-tool lookup the cheap default by removing ToolSearch friction, add a non-blocking reminder at grep invocation time, and encode the correct division of labour distinguishing symbol-call-site lookup from string-literal or stale-index cases.
